title: Milestone Gears IPO
summary: Milestone Gears IPO is a book-built issue of about ₹1,100 crore, to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO opens on December 4, 2026 and closes on December 8, 2026, with allotment expected on December 9 and listing on December 11, 2026. The price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Milestone Gears IPO has a total issue size of ₹1100 Crores Approx. and will be listed on BSE and NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: JM Financial Ltd., Axis Capital Ltd., Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Ltd.

b.p: Data sourced from DRHP / RHP • For educational purposes only
Milestone Gears financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Since its incorporation in 1984, Milestone Gears Limited has been involved in the production of sophisticated high precision engineering transmission parts utilized in various industries such as tractors, construction machinery, electric vehicles, locomotives, windmills and other heavy industries. · The firm produces transmission parts for Indian as well as overseas original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and their related firms. They have built a good reputation of having a long-lasting relationship with their top ten customers whose average tenure exceeds 18 years as at fiscal year 2025. · · Products produced by Milestone Gears Limited include bull gears, rear axles, spindles, internal ring gears and bevel gears catering to sectors such as agriculture, construction machinery, electric vehicles, locomotives and wind energy. Milestone Gears Limited is continually broadening its product range in order to increase its market share. · As at June 30, 2025, the firm had a total of 1,417 permanent workers and 2,038 contractual workers.
Ashok Kumar Tandon, Aman Tandon are the company's promoters of Milestone Gears.
